snippet.title: Paradox Protocol // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3617470/Paradox_Protocol/

Paradox Protocol is a 1-6 player co-op horror experience. Either alone or as a team you find yourselves in a procedurally generated map filled with mystery, puzzles and danger lurking within. Scavenge the map for resources and gear to help you complete puzzles and try to escape.

Developed by 
Nightmare Nexus LTD
